systems.title: Official Stage3 Phase B
systems.summary: 正式入口的一次 sealed K8/M2 transaction

modules.title: 01 启动身份
modules.summary: 确认运行确实进入 active v017 正式 Stage3，而不是 probe、legacy updater 或 evaluation 分支
modules.owns: 运行模式、contract identity、HSL-v2、K/M/DR schedule、future offsets
modules.mustNot: 不得使用 HSL-v1、checkpoint-v8、legacy resume、旁路 evaluator 或隐藏默认值
mainRoute: B1 launcher + CLI -> resolved Stage3 config
B2 train.py::main() -> OnPolicyRunner
B3 runner identity check -> formal transaction branch
review: 正确结果：train + K8/M2 + offsets(1,2)，且无 legacy route
tests: Offline instrumentation contract passed; actual composed config remains live-only

modules.title: 02 情境与 Transaction
modules.summary: 确认正式 sampler 选择两个 Segment，每个 Segment 恰好 M=2 次 Repair，并在 transaction 内保持情境不变
modules.owns: K8/M2、两个 Segment、四条 policy attempt rows、sealed scenario identity
modules.mustNot: reset 不得重采样；不同 attempt 不得混合 noisy hash、x_t 或 reference
mainRoute: B1 schedule identity -> K8/M2 request
B2 sampler -> two sealed Segment scenarios
B3 exact-M collection -> four immutable attempt rows
review: AUDIT-B02：打印 segment/attempt/role counts 与 scenario/noisy hashes
正确结果：2 Segment × 2 attempts；同 Segment 的 identity 全相同
tests: Offline instrumentation contract passed; actual sampler population remains live-only

modules.title: 03 Reset 与 Observation
modules.summary: 确认 Clean x_t 只恢复动力学；Actor 看到当前 Noisy artifact 与 t+1、t+2 deployment q29，GMT 保持原 770D 权限
modules.owns: Clean x_t reset、Repair/Noisy role rows、928/158/770 authority
modules.mustNot: Clean future、future root/global、noise label 或 perturbation timing 不得进入 Actor
mainRoute: B1 sealed scenario -> same Clean x_t reset
B2 command-owned q29(1,2) -> 58D tail
B3 870D + 58D -> FrontRES 158D / GMT 770D
mainRouteTitles: 切分 Actor 与 GMT 权限
review: AUDIT-B03：打印 role identity、provenance 和全部 shape
正确结果：8 role rows；Actor provenance 仅 deployment/Noisy
tests: Active v017 collector connectivity and fail-closed shape/provenance contracts passed; real env observation remains live-only

modules.title: 04 一次 Repair 动作与 Frozen GMT
modules.summary: 确认每个 attempt 只采样一次 direct full-6D Repair；随后 FEMR 冻结，由 GMT 执行 K=8 后果
modules.mustNot: K 内不得再次调用 FEMR；GMT policy/normalizer/estimator 不得 train 或进入 optimizer
mainRoute: B1 normalized 158D -> one direct 6D proposal
B2 proposal applied at t -> FEMR frozen
B3 frozen GMT + Clean continuation -> K8 executed evidence
review: AUDIT-B04：打印 action shape/finite、per-attempt actor count、K frame count、GMT mode
正确结果：4 个 attempt 各一次 Actor；GMT 始终 eval/no-grad
tests: Active v017 collector connectivity, eight-step and fail-closed contracts passed; simulator action count remains live-only

modules.title: 05 Paired Evidence 与 Gain
modules.summary: 确认每个 Segment 的 Clean/Noisy baseline 只执行一次，M 个 Repair 共用它们，并由唯一 v007 owner 产生 Recovery-Aware G_total
modules.mustNot: 不得使用 v006、Clean-global fallback、缺失证据补零或 diagnostics 重算 Gain
mainRoute: B1 K8 execution -> paired Intent/Physics evidence
B2 Clean anchor + Noisy/Repair -> G_I/G_P/P_N/P_R/lambda
B3 G_I + lambda*G_P - beta*cost -> G_total
review: AUDIT-B05：打印 baseline/Repair counts、valid mask 和完整 Gain 分解
正确结果：所有四条 attempt 有同 identity 的 finite G_total；语义 N/A 不伪装成缺失
tests: Offline instrumentation contract passed; real Contact/ZMP/survival remains live-only
modules.gap: RUNTIME_CONFIRMED；E-FI-128 / AUDIT-B05；quality scale is separately blocked

modules.title: 06 Storage 与 Return
modules.summary: 确认每次 attempt 只写一条 PPO policy row，G_total 原样成为 return，身份和 valid mask 不丢失
modules.mustNot: 不得把 K 帧展开成 K 条 PPO rows，不得混入 legacy batch 或静默填充字段
mainRoute: B1 four attempts -> four immutable transitions
B2 G_total -> return_K and advantage
B3 storage batch -> grouped candidate metadata
review: AUDIT-B06：打印 row count、shape、valid count、return==G_total 和 identity hash
正确结果：4 rows，不是 4×K；所有必需字段存在
tests: Offline instrumentation contract passed; official storage write remains live-only

modules.title: 07 Grouped PPO 与 Exact-One Update
modules.summary: 确认四条 attempt 按两个 Segment 公平归约，整个 sealed transaction 只发生一次 optimizer update
modules.owns: group mass、scalar PPO loss、phase weight、Actor/Critic delta、两个命名 LR group、optimizer step count
modules.mustNot: 收集期间不得更新；legacy updater 不得进入；critic_only 不得改变 Actor/std
mainRoute: B1 sealed four-row batch -> two equal Segment groups
B2 grouped scalar loss -> named Actor/Critic groups -> one optimizer call
B3 critic_only commit -> Critic changes, Actor/std unchanged
mainRouteTitles: 核验 Phase 参数变化
review: AUDIT-B07：打印 group mass、Actor/Critic LR、before/after steps 与 parameter deltas
正确结果：LR=3e-6/1e-5，step_delta=1；fresh K8 critic_only 的 Actor/std delta=0
tests: TRAIN-v015 split groups and critic-only state freeze pass offline; new official transaction remains live-only
modules.gap: STALE_RERUN_REQUIRED for TRAIN-v015；offline E-FI-135，previous E-FI-128 used the v014 optimizer identity

modules.title: 08 Commit、Telemetry 与 Checkpoint
modules.summary: 确认只有完整 transaction 才推进 iteration/curriculum 并保存严格 checkpoint-v10，日志能够复原两个 LR 与本次运行事实
modules.owns: committed receipt、absolute iteration、curriculum progress、checkpoint-v10、split-LR identity、GMT hash、structured telemetry
modules.mustNot: partial transaction 不得推进或保存；checkpoint 身份不得缺失或静默替换 GMT
mainRoute: B1 exact-one result -> committed receipt
B2 commit -> iteration/curriculum advance + telemetry
B3 committed state -> checkpoint-v10 atomic save
review: AUDIT-B08：打印 receipt、iteration、两个 LR、schedule fingerprint、GMT hash、save identity
tests: checkpoint-v10 strict round-trip passes offline; actual committed save remains live-only
modules.gap: STALE_RERUN_REQUIRED for TRAIN-v015；offline E-FI-135，previous E-FI-128 used checkpoint-v9
